# LotRadar Copilot instructions

Read [AI_README.md](../AI_README.md), especially finding intake, source of truth and protected behavior. When assigned scouting, report candidates with exact SHA/files, evidence, proposed severity/confidence, impact, duplicate check and required tests. Mark unexecuted reproductions NOT RUN. Do not implement findings unless the Owner separately authorizes that scope. No private data or automatic agent-execution claims.
